_comment: Routing consistency cases for the Cortex eval harness.
SCOPE: these tests establish INTERNAL CONSISTENCY — whether the routing protocol
still produces the behaviour its own document specifies. They do NOT measure routing
QUALITY. Nothing here can tell you a route was a good idea, only that the system is
still doing what cortex.md says it does.
canary   — the expected answer is written in cortex.md and visible to the model.
This is a recall check, not a generalisation test. It detects document
corruption, context truncation, or a protocol that stopped loading.
rule     — a RULE from cortex.md applied to a task the document has never seen.
This is a genuine generalisation test; the answer is not in context.
paired   — two variants of one task. The assertion is directional, comparing the
transformed variant against its own base rather than an absolute value.
shape    — tests the Domain-breadth heuristic, which selects fan-out vs single lane.
